test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only three people sit between X and Y when counted from the left of X. Only three people sit between Z and U when counted from the right of U. V sits to the immediate right of Z. W is an immediate neighbour of U as well as Y. Who sits to the second to the left of A?
solution: Given: U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Only three people sit between Z and U when counted from the right of U. 2) V sits to the immediate right of Z.
